消費 consumption の隣に、成就 consummation がある

Consumption means using up. Consummation means bringing something to fulfillment. The words look strangely similar, but Dewey's aesthetics pushes them in almost opposite directions. 「作品を見終える」から「一つの経験が成就する」まで何が起きるのかを、doing / undergoing、recognition / perception、continuityを通して考える。
